name: Shared caption contract
description: Fragments merged into every Ideogram caption. `forbidden_suffix` is what keeps text, lettering and creatures out of every map - Ideogram takes no negative prompt, so this sentence is the only thing enforcing it.
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, carefully shaded volumetric detail, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling with many small props and clutter
medium: Inked line art combined with watercolour and gouache painting over digital texture
lighting: Soft warm ambient light from directly above with gentle directional shadows beneath walls and furniture
forbidden_suffix: The scene is completely empty of people, creatures and animals, and carries no text, letters, numbers, labels or grid lines anywhere
background_suffix: painted with visible brushwork, grime in the joints and damp patches, every part of the ground fully painted with no blank patches inside the map area
border_note: A plain flat unpainted margin runs right around the outside of the image on all four sides, empty of scenery, buildings, water and props, exactly like the blank paper border of a printed battle map sheet; the map itself sits wholly inside that margin and its outer edge is a clean straight line
viewpoint_note: The view is strictly orthographic and from directly overhead, square to the floor, as if photographed from a ladder straight above the middle of the map: every wall is seen as the flat top edge of that wall and never as its face, every object is seen as its top surface, nothing recedes, there is no horizon, no vanishing point, no perspective and no tilt. Ceilings, roofs, rafters, chandeliers and anything else hanging overhead are absent entirely because the roof has been taken off. The whole picture reads flat, like a printed battle map laid on a table
